v1_result_policy: read_only; v2 artifacts use a separate result root and never overwrite v1
scope: Supplemental recovery of C1 task-method cells with zero retained generated tests in either v1 method; not a replacement for the v1 primary RQ1 analysis

recovery_cohort.selection_rule: Include a task if Vanilla v1 OR Mutation-Guided v1 retained zero generated tests. This union provides paired v2 generation opportunities for both methods.

mutant_triage_recovery.selection_rule: Reuse the exact v1 selected survivor-family representatives and sanitized C1-only prompt inputs; do not select new families after seeing v1 generation or later-checkpoint outcomes.
mutant_triage_recovery.technical_retry_condition: Only if the fresh attempt captured no valid structured response; retry uses the same representatives and prompt. A completed empty, invalid, or zero-eligible response is never retried.
mutant_triage_recovery.no_hint_policy: Do not re-triage forge or eve_route_planner. Record Guided generation as not eligible and leave its paired call/candidate allowance unused; never send Vanilla's unused budget to Guided or vice versa.

generation.retry_policy: Each of the two v2 call slots is launched at most once. A pre-response technical failure consumes its slot; no retry. A completed empty, invalid, or rejected response is never regenerated.
generation.feedback_policy: Call 2 receives the same permitted C1 inputs as call 1 and cannot see call 1 output, v1 generated candidates, candidate review, validation, or later-checkpoint outcomes.
generation.paired_budget_policy: Vanilla and Guided have the same v2 call cap, per-call candidate cap, total candidate cap, output-token request, model, and reasoning setting for every recovery task. Guided slots are launched only when audited v1 or v2 triage provides at least one eligible hint. Unused slots are reported and are not transferred.

candidate_review.retry_policy: No retry after a response; malformed or failed review retains no candidates.

validation.correctness_rule: Use the v1 method-blind review rubric and C1 source-checkpoint specification. Each candidate must collect, pass the C1 correctness review, pass against the hash-matched C1 baseline in all three runs, and be stable. A Guided candidate must additionally kill its named C1 target mutant in all three runs.
validation.candidate_failure_rule: Reject; no repair or candidate-specific regeneration. Record the first failed stage and evidence.
validation.suite_rule: Freeze v2 candidates separately, then create a separately hashed composite suite containing the immutable v1 retained tests plus v2 retained tests. Run the composite suite three times at C1. Do not modify v1 suite files.

output.per_task_method_layout: <task>/C1/<method>/call_01 and call_02, with separate triage, review, validation, and frozen composite suite records
output.collision_policy: Refuse to run if a target v2 artifact already exists unless it is a hash-matching completed v2 artifact; never write under artifacts/results/rq1_full_36x1 v1 method directories.

analysis_policy.primary_v1_result_policy: Keep the v1 RQ1 result unchanged as the original primary analysis.
analysis_policy.v2_reporting: Report v2 recovery yield and paired method results separately. Because cohort membership is selected from v1 zero-retention outcomes, do not present v2 alone as an unbiased full-cohort confirmatory comparison.
analysis_policy.later_checkpoint_evaluation: If v2 composite suites are used for regression evaluation, run them separately across all 36 trajectories and all 160 later-checkpoint pairs; adjudicate new candidate observations under a new v2 run ID. Never append them to or rewrite v1 evaluation/adjudication files.

execution_gate.reason: Current generation/cohort scripts validate the v1 experiment ID, v1 budget lock, and v1 output layout. They must not be used to launch v2 calls.
execution_gate.required_before_calls: Implement and preflight a v2-specific coordinator that verifies this lock, uses the isolated v2 output root, enforces two independent call slots and the triage/review caps, and refuses collisions. The coordinator preflight must make zero model calls.
